recent_articles.title: Submerged temple emerges as Bhavanisagar Dam level drops - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Bhavanisagar Dam**'s water level dropping to 59 ft. has revealed the dilapidated **Sri Madhava Perumal Temple**, which was submerged during construction in the 1940s and 1950s. The temple was last visible in 2024 when the water level dropped, and fishermen report that portions of the structure become visible again at lower water levels.
